_about: The Haunted House and the abandoned carnival beyond it (levels 10-20): poltergeists, the phantom servants and the haunted armour answer each other; the ghost-girl only weeps; the creation in the basement laboratory is a sub-boss; the Lord of the House in the master bedroom darkens the house and sends his poltergeists. At the carnival the dead performers answer the calliope, the two-headed tiger is an elite, Sorcha the seer only tells fortunes, and Nis the clown of the Fun-House is a sub-boss.

48200.name: poltergeist
48200.long_desc: A poltergeist hurls a candlestick across the room.
48200.description: A shape you only see out of the corner of your eye, and a temper you see all too clearly.

helpers.shout: A door slams somewhere in the house, and the dead come to see!

48201.name: phantom butler
48201.long_desc: The phantom butler stands ready, a tray of nothing in his hands.
48201.description: Starched collar, grey face, eyes like holes. He is still waiting for the master to ring.

helpers.shout: A door slams somewhere in the house, and the dead come to see!

48202.name: ghoulish cook
48202.long_desc: The ghoulish cook stirs a pot of something grey.
48202.description: Flour-white and bloated, her apron stained with things that are not gravy.

helpers.shout: A door slams somewhere in the house, and the dead come to see!

48203.name: haunted armour suit
48203.long_desc: A suit of armour stands in the foyer, and its visor turns to follow you.
48203.description: Old plate on a stand, rust at the joints, and nothing inside but cold air and anger.

helpers.shout: A door slams somewhere in the house, and the dead come to see!

48204.name: weeping maid ghost
48204.long_desc: A weeping maid scrubs at a stain that will never come out.
48204.description: A thin girl in a maid's cap, translucent, her hands red-raw from a scrubbing that has gone on for a hundred years.

helpers.shout: A door slams somewhere in the house, and the dead come to see!

48205.name: ghost girl little
48205.long_desc: A little ghost-girl sits on the bed, hugging a doll.
48205.description: A child in a nightdress, pale and solemn. She does not want to fight; she wants someone to find her mother.

48206.name: creation patchwork
48206.long_desc: A patchwork creation strains against its chains on the laboratory table.
48206.description: Stitched together from a dozen bodies, with bolts at the neck and a lightning-scar down its face. The family's last son built it, and it killed him.

48210.name: lord house ghost
48210.long_desc: The Lord of the House rises from the bed, his nightshirt stained dark.
48210.description: The master of the house, dead these hundred years, in the room where he died. Every ghost here belongs to him, and he does not let anyone leave.

helpers.shout: A door slams somewhere in the house, and the dead come to see!

phases.message: The Lord of the House roars: "GET OUT OF MY HOUSE!"

abilities.name: Cold Wind
abilities.telegraph: The Lord of the House screams, and an icy wind tears through the room!

abilities.name: Grave Grip
abilities.telegraph: The Lord of the House reaches for your throat!

abilities.name: Possession
abilities.telegraph: The Lord of the House tries to climb inside you!

48220.name: dead performer carnival
48220.long_desc: A dead performer grins at you in faded greasepaint.
48220.description: Spangles, rotten silk and a painted smile on a skull. The show must go on.

helpers.shout: A calliope wheezes into life, and the carnival's dead come running!

48221.name: tiger two-headed
48221.long_desc: The two-headed tiger paces its den, both heads snarling.
48221.description: A great striped cat with two heads that do not like each other, and like you less.

48222.name: sorcha seer
48222.long_desc: Sorcha the seer shuffles her cards and smiles.
48222.description: An old woman in scarves and coins, the only living soul at the carnival. Her cards are never wrong.

48223.name: nis clown
48223.long_desc: Nis the clown waves from the mouth of the Fun-House, his grin far too wide.
48223.description: Painted white, red-nosed, his teeth filed to points. The Fun-House is his, and nobody laughs in it but him.

helpers.shout: A calliope wheezes into life, and the carnival's dead come running!

patrols.why: a poltergeist roams the ground floor

bosses.why: the Lord of the House in the Master Bedroom

mechanics.shout: Every candle in the house goes out at once...
The Lord of the House shrieks, and poltergeists burst through the walls!
